title: Agent Memory Challenge Cycle 2 Text/Coding Add/Search API
description: Wire contract for participant-hosted Textual/Coding memory Add and Search endpoints. This schema does not prove persistence, authorization, immediate searchability, or deployment compliance.

messages.description: Ordered source messages; preserve the exact order.

session_id.description: Source session grouping metadata; not a Search filter.

query.description: Original benchmark query. Search must not return a generated answer or use gold labels.

options.description: Optional top-level answer choices; omit for open-ended questions.

user_id.description: Sole retrieval isolation scope; must match Add.

top_k.description: Maximum number of evidence items to return; formal evaluations use 100.

content.description: Evidence content, not a generated answer.

score.description: Optional relevance score; greater means more relevant.

data.description: Relevance-ordered; empty results must be data: [].

x-runtimeInvariants: Add returns HTTP 200 only after durable persistence and immediate Search visibility.
Add success echoes request_id, user_id, and session_id byte-for-byte.
A retry of the same logical write keeps the same request_id and identical payload.
Search uses user_id as the only retrieval-isolation field; session_id is not sent to Search.
Search response order is preserved by the platform and must already be ranked by relevance.
Search response item count must not exceed top_k; overflow is a contract error, not a truncate-and-pass condition.
Search returns evidence only; no final answer, evaluator label, or gold answer.
Do not send metadata, app_id, agent_id, async_mode, or unapproved Search filters.
The synchronous default is HTTP 200. HTTP 202 is only permitted when the submitted version has an approved Add task-status endpoint.
Open-source Methods uses text-embedding-v4 for embeddings and gpt-4o-mini for LLM-related components; rerankers are unrestricted.
Evaluation data is for evaluation only, must not be used for training or shared, and must be deleted within 30 days after the run.
